strengths: Standardised microbiome multi-omics pipeline built on SummarizedExperiment/MultiAssayExperiment with five end-to-end modules.
limitations: Microbiome-centric; inherits Bioconductor learning curve and limited support for non-microbiome modalities.

strengths: Generates factor-analysis-based simulated multi-omics datasets with controllable latent structure, noise and complexity.
limitations: Simulation-only utility; provides no integration methods or downstream analysis or visualisation modules.

strengths: Web-based pipeline covering single-omics analysis, knowledge-driven network and data-driven joint DR integration.
limitations: GUI-dependent; constrained scalability, customisation and reproducibility for very large or locally controlled studies.

strengths: Generic framework for pre-processing, modelling and clustering of longitudinal multi-omics data to identify time-associated features.
limitations: Restricted to longitudinal designs with aligned time points; limited guidance on missingness and non-microbiome modalities.
